recommendations.title: Implement Comprehensive Test Coverage for Dashboard Components
recommendations.description: Create missing tests for Dashboard v3 components to reach 80%+ coverage. Focus on orchestrator, collectors, and tab JavaScript components.
implementation_steps: Add unit tests for use-cases-tab.js and recommendations-tab.js
Create integration tests for tab data loading
Add E2E tests for tab switching and rendering
recommendations.expected_outcome: Increased confidence in dashboard stability, reduced regression bugs

recommendations.title: Fix Business Capability Detector Interface
recommendations.description: BusinessCapabilityDetector has analyze() method but orchestrator expects collect(). Create adapter or refactor to match collector interface.
implementation_steps: Add collect() method to BusinessCapabilityDetector
Map analyze() results to collector output format
Update orchestrator tests to verify integration
recommendations.expected_outcome: Orchestrator can successfully collect business capability data

recommendations.title: Fix RecommendationCollector Security Data Type Mismatch
recommendations.description: generate_security_recommendations() expects vulnerabilities to be int but receives dict. Update type handling or collector interface.
implementation_steps: Add type validation in generate_security_recommendations()
Extract vulnerability count from dict if needed
Add defensive programming for unexpected data types
recommendations.expected_outcome: Recommendation collector handles security data correctly

recommendations.title: Consolidate Dashboard Architecture Documentation
recommendations.description: Update docs to reflect single production dashboard approach. Remove references to deprecated Dashboard v3 templates.
implementation_steps: Update README with production dashboard URL
Archive or delete DASHBOARD-V3-PROGRESS.md
Add documentation for tab JSON file structure
recommendations.expected_outcome: Clear documentation of current dashboard architecture

recommendations.title: Add Performance Monitoring to Dashboard Data Pipeline
recommendations.description: Track Phase 7→8→9 pipeline execution time, identify bottlenecks, optimize slow collectors.
implementation_steps: Add timing decorators to collector methods
Log phase execution times
Create performance dashboard tab
recommendations.expected_outcome: Visibility into pipeline performance, ability to optimize slow phases

recommendations.title: Implement Caching for Dashboard Data Collection
recommendations.description: Cache collected data with TTL to avoid redundant scans. Particularly useful for large repositories.
implementation_steps: Add cache directory structure
Implement TTL-based cache invalidation
Add cache hit/miss metrics
recommendations.expected_outcome: Faster dashboard refreshes, reduced repository scanning overhead

recommendations.title: Add Export Functionality to All Dashboard Tabs
recommendations.description: Allow users to export tab data as JSON, CSV, or Markdown for external analysis and reporting.
implementation_steps: Create export utility module
Add export buttons to each tab
Support JSON, CSV, and Markdown formats
recommendations.expected_outcome: Users can export dashboard data for offline analysis

recommendations.title: Implement Real-time Dashboard Updates
recommendations.description: Add WebSocket or polling mechanism to auto-refresh dashboard when repository changes detected.
implementation_steps: Add file watcher for repository changes
Implement WebSocket server
Add client-side auto-refresh logic
recommendations.expected_outcome: Dashboard stays up-to-date without manual refresh

recommendations.title: Create Dashboard Comparison View
recommendations.description: Allow side-by-side comparison of dashboard data across multiple repositories or time periods.
implementation_steps: Add comparison tab to dashboard
Implement multi-repo data loading
Create diff visualization components
recommendations.expected_outcome: Users can compare repositories or track changes over time

recommendations.title: Add Security Vulnerability Scanner Integration
recommendations.description: Integrate with Snyk, npm audit, or pip-audit to detect and display security vulnerabilities in dashboard.
implementation_steps: Add vulnerability scanner CLI integration
Parse scanner output into dashboard format
Display vulnerabilities by severity in Security tab
recommendations.expected_outcome: Proactive security vulnerability detection and reporting
